info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Account Txpush-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the removal of transaction push notifications associated with a specific customer account. By utilizing the DELETE method, users can efficiently clear out outdated or unwanted transaction push settings. Typical consumers include developers managing customer account settings in finance or ecommerce platforms. The API ensures that transaction notifications are accurately updated to reflect user preferences and enhance their overall experience.

delete.summary: Delete a transaction push notification for a specific account.
delete.description: This operation allows you to remove a transaction push notification that has been set up for a specific account. It ensures that no further notifications will be sent regarding the specified transactions for that account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to push a transaction for the specified account. The operation will require appropriate identifiers and details formatted in JSON to ensure successful transaction handling.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.

DeleteAccountTxpushRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting an operation related to a specific account transaction push.

DeleteAccountTxpushResponse_204.title: Delete Transaction Response
DeleteAccountTxpushResponse_204.description: Schema representing the response for a DELETE operation related to a specific transaction.
